metadata.name: Malaysia Public Transport GTFS Static Snapshot
metadata.source: Official GTFS static ZIP files downloaded from data.gov.my
metadata.coverage: 15 supplied feeds: Rapid Penang, Rapid KL bus and rail, MRT feeder, KTMB, and 10 BAS/MyBAS areas
metadata.fareNotice: The supplied GTFS files contain no fare tables. baseFare values are prototype minimum estimates, not ticket quotations.
metadata.accessibilityNotice: The supplied feeds do not declare wheelchair data. Unknown values remain enabled because the app model only supports true/false.
metadata.liveStatusNotice: This file is GTFS static data. liveSupported is false until a GTFS Realtime API is integrated.
